notes.title: My publisher went out of business, but I'm still finishing ChainStaff.
notes.notes: [p]I wish I had great news, but I have a bit of ... not great but not terrible news. I lost my publisher, Null games. Well, I didn't LOSE them, they dissolved (I don't know why).[/p][p][/p][p]What does this mean for ChainStaff? It means I have to do all the marketing, promotion, and community building myself, in addition to making and producing the game. That's is a lot work! But don't worry, [/p][p]I've done it before with my past games. [/p][p][/p][p]Why is it [b]not TERRIBLE[/b] news? Because I can spend a little more time balancing the game and not rushing to release it this Fall (to fit the publisher's schedule). I absolutely [b]LOVE[/b] ChainStaff and excited to make it the best game I can.[/p][p][/p][p]The game was scheduled for release in Fall 2025. That's not going to happen any more, BUT don't worry, I don't plan on taking another year to finish the game or anything like that. The game is probably 85% [/p][p]complete, so that's great! My current "release window" is [b]Spring 2026[/b].  More info when I have it sorted out. [/p][p][/p][p]As for you all, the game demo is still live here on Steam (as of this writing), so if you could help me spread the word about how cool the game is to your friends, and  even your favorite influencers, that would be a big help![/p][p][/p][p]And if you want to get into the [b]closed beta[/b], to play the game before release and help me balance the game and improve it, join my mailing list. I'll be doing the beta through here:[/p][p][url="https://subscribepage.io/Mk6GOH"]https://subscribepage.io/Mk6GOH[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]TLDR:[/b] Game is still coming out! I'm working hard on it, probably out more like Spring 2026.[/p][p]Thank you for all your encouragement and support! It really helps with my motivation to do a great job and finish the game strong. -Nathan[/p]

notes.title: Play the Demo Now
notes.notes:
It’s here! The ChainStaff demo has landed, but so did the giant aliens and their brutish minions. Spear, swing, and shoot your way through a transformed version of Earth to save mankind. The demo will be live through Steam Next Fest, so get in your run’n’gun time.

Here’s what you can expect from the demo:
[list]
[*] [b]Get to grips[/b]
Learn to harness the ChainStaff’s murderous and varied powers in the Tutorial training grounds before taking the fight back to the invading alien scum
[*] [b]Beautiful devastation[/b]
Explore ChainStaff’s first level, Sand Spires, and gawk in awe and horror at once scenic views turned to surreal and otherworldly landscapes
[*] [b]Dangerous species[/b]
Shoot, stab and spear your way through several types of mutant fiends and catch a glimpse of what to expect from the many enemy variants the Star Spores will bring to the battlefield at full release
[*] [b]Bring your best[/b]
Deploy your flesh-ripping arsenal against the first of the game’s many gargantuan bosses, all of which will require precision use of your weaponry to resist and overcome their dreadful attacks
[*] [b]Grotesque upgrades[/b]
Your comrades are stranded across the wasteland of the Sand Spires, helpless to resist the Star Spores on their own. You can choose to send them back to base with a rescue for tech upgrades, or feed the alien beast on your head by devouring their organs to make you more powerful.
[/list]
Be sure to share any gruesome deaths or visceral enemy eliminations in the [url=https://discord.gg/mommysbestgames]Mommy’s Best Games Discord[/url].

notes.title: Gamedev Update 4: Getting a 3D Look out of 2D

Howdy everyone!
I've been hard at work on making lots of cool monster animations. I like seeing all the texture in a hand-painted HD game. I want to give ChainStaff an extra bit of polish so I've been using Spine Animation to make the game look slightly 3D.

notes.title: ChainStaff is coming to SXSW Sydney!

notes.title: Gamedev Update 2: Fixing Framerates over 60fps
notes.notes:
I recently visited PAX West show off the game and it was great fun. However, the PCs were faster than my work rig, and I noticed the game physics was having issues at the super high framerates. 

In this development video I show how I fixed the player swinging, guns, and even some environmental effects to handled higher framerates when building my game in Unity.

(Shuhei Yoshida even came out to play my game at PAX West!)
[previewyoutube=BL-VhL9oYeI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
